result.reason: The clause adds the preferred mutual monetary cap, preserves the mutual consequential-damages exclusion, and includes uncapped indemnification, gross-negligence, wilful-misconduct, fraud and IP-infringement claims, plus the payment-obligations clarification. However, the operative language does not expressly carve out breaches of data protection and security obligations, so it does not reach the preferred position; the margin comment cannot cure that omission. It appears to meet the fallback if Sections 13 or 14 cover confidentiality. Also, measuring fees from the event giving rise to the claim, rather than from the claim, deviates from the stated formulation and may make an aggregate cap uncertain where multiple events are involved.
